none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: The setup permits differentiable, nonconvex objectives on ℝᵈ. There is a global lower bound ℓ with f(x₀) − ℓ ≤ Δ. Attainment of the infimum is optional.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: One call at x returns the full vector g(x,ξ) using a fresh IID seed. The map g is jointly measurable, and its reply is integrable with mean ∇f(x). The public input gives d, B, the block assignment, the measurable seed space Ω, x₀, L, σ, Δ, and ε. The objective, oracle map, and seed law are hidden.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/BlockHeterogeneousNonconvex.lean, Params, spec.publicInput, spec.Reply, and spec.admissible. LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean, IID

distinctive_assumptions.label: bounded_variance
distinctive_assumptions.details: At every x, each projected oracle error has second moment E‖Pⱼ(g(x,ξ) − ∇f(x))‖₂² ≤ σⱼ². The public bounds σⱼ ≥ 0 may differ or vanish. Errors in different blocks of the same reply may be correlated.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The domain is Euclidean ℝᵈ. A public assignment partitions the coordinates into B labeled blocks. Pⱼ is the orthogonal projection onto block j, which may be empty.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Each block has a public Lⱼ > 0. For every x and displacement h, the simultaneous Taylor remainder satisfies |f(x+h) − f(x) − ⟨∇f(x),h⟩| ≤ ½ Σⱼ Lⱼ‖Pⱼh‖₂².

accuracy.label: gradient_norm
accuracy.details: For the returned point X, stationarity is measured by the unsquared mixed norm Σⱼ ‖Pⱼ∇f(X)‖₂. The output may be any measurable point in ℝᵈ.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: The mixed norm must be integrable and satisfy E[Σⱼ ‖Pⱼ∇f(X)‖₂] ≤ ε for public ε > 0. The expectation covers the algorithm seed and the IID oracle stream under their product law. The oracle-call budget is fixed.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/BlockHeterogeneousNonconvex.lean, spec.valid and spec.successful. LongTails/Template.lean, executeWithTrace and Convergence

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The same coordinate partition governs the smoothness bound, the noise bounds, and the stationarity criterion. A single oracle call observes all blocks, while accuracy sums their individual Euclidean gradient norms.
